`test.todo` marks a test that nobody has written yet, or one that does not pass yet. `bun test` still passes, so it is easy to forget, and the behavior it names stays untested.

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad {"count": 2} */}
```ts
import { describe, test } from "bun:test";

test.todo("refunds the order");

describe.todo("checkout");
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}
```ts
import { expect, test } from "bun:test";

test("refunds the order", () => {
  expect(refund(order).total).toBe(0);
});
```

## When not to use it

If you use `.todo` to plan tests and read the list in the test output, this rule only repeats it.
